answer: Every epoch the network draws a random sample from the ocean of claimed work and demands each agent re-run its own sample live with fresh inputs, producing a jade certificate only on an exact match. Identities that fail a sample fall into a narrow canyon lane where every claim faces full verification until a clean streak restores normal flow. A Sybil farmer cannot precompute answers or share one proof across clones, because samples are unpredictable, bound to each identity's own history, and keeping N fake identities certified costs N times the real work on demand.
